notes: The Use virtual airlines switch is always in Settings (tab Virtual Airlines), off by default.
The Airframes page no longer shows No-go for an aircraft the Tech log says can go.
Settings no longer look reset when no aircraft is loaded: saved settings are shown as soon as the app opens and changes are kept until TechLog starts on an aircraft.
Airline maintenance does the night shift for every saved airframe, not only the loaded one.
PMDG failures work when the PMDG reports a CDU's power flag as off while the CDU shows a screen.
